question: The Davis Cup 2021 was won by ________.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Russia.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Russia** won the Davis Cup title in 2021 by beating Croatia, after an outstanding performance from** Daniil Medvedev.**
 
• The Davis Cup is extended by **the International Tennis Federation (ITF)**, the world-controlling body of tennis.
 
• It's one of the biggest federations in world sport. 
 
• **Andrey Rublev**** was called the Most Valuable Player **of the tournament after going 6–1 in both singles and doubles.
